data.one_liner: Create customizable bullet lists with support for ordered, unordered, and nested items.
data.what_it_does: Effortlessly generates bullet lists with customizable styles, spacing, and support for multiple levels of nested items using standard Flutter widgets.
use_when: You need to display ordered or unordered lists with bullet points.
You require nested lists with customizable marker styles.
avoid_when: You need complex data-driven list view virtualization for massive datasets.
strengths: Supports both ordered and unordered lists
Allows deep nesting of list items
weaknesses: Does not automatically scale custom widget sizes with icon sizes
Limited documentation on advanced customization beyond basic properties
data.minimal_example:
SuperBulletList(
  isOrdered: false,
  items: [
    Text('Item 1'),
    Text('Item 2'),
  ],
)
